name: open-eclass-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for Open eClass. Kept apart from the app's package.json.

scripts.test:e2e:install: bun run e2e:reset && ECLASS_E2E_INSTALL=1 playwright test
scripts.e2e:mountpoints: cd ../.. && mkdir -p vendor js/mathjax js/h5p-standalone js/recordrtc js/video.js resources/fonts/mathjax-newcm-font storage
scripts.e2e:up: bun run e2e:mountpoints && bun run e2e:compose up -d --wait
scripts.e2e:reset: bun run e2e:compose down -v && bun run e2e:mountpoints && bun run e2e:compose up -d --wait --build
